messages:
alyssa: heads-up — console team is prototyping a routing analytics tile that shows per-route quota burn, fallback rates, and a small heatmap for policy hits. thinking about exposing a new opt-in telemetry header to make attribution easier. WDYT?
jack.platform: +1 on the tile. main concern is telemetry volume. if we add per-request route metadata we need sampling and storage strategy. :thinking_face:
priya: do we want per-route quotas surfaced by default? customers with many routes might find it noisy. maybe keep collapsed by prefix.
matt: SDK perspective: make it strictly opt-in. propose a flag `client.enableRouteMeta(true)` that toggles sending `X-Redwood-Route-Meta`. default should be false so no behavior change.
sara: UX: show an estimated telemetry cost delta and retention warning before people enable it. also copy around PII risk.
alyssa: agreed. proposed header shape: `X-Redwood-Route-Meta: route=<route_id>;policy=<policy_name|id>` — lightweight. we should probably hash route_id for privacy if customers want.
jack.platform: hashed id is safer. also consider a boolean `route_present=1` + `route_hash=abc123` to keep it tiny. previous large headers caused cache misses.
priya: quota scoping question: dashboards should let you pivot between customer-level, route-level, and model-variant-level. core API needs to emit a scope field so pipeline can aggregate correctly.
matt: on SDKs: we'll add helper to compute header and validate format. languages: py/ts/go. low-risk change if opt-in. can we standardize env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_META=1` for dev/test?
alyssa: yes, include env var and snippet in quickstart. also add a console toggle: "Include route metadata in telemetry (opt-in)" with an info tooltip.
jack.platform: infra action item: need an indexing plan. we can't full-index for all tenants. maybe timebox index for 30d and roll off. I'll file an infra ticket.
sara: also add a confirm modal explaining retention/cost if enabling org-wide. small banner for canary teams.
matt: tests: ensure header absent by default, present when enabled, and properly formatted. add e2e with canary flag.
priya: anything breaking? since default is false, shouldn't break. edge case: customers parsing headers themselves may be surprised if they enable. doc that in upgrade notes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/console-routing-tiles -> canary on frontend-prod-3. ETA 10m. :rocket:
alyssa: thanks — i'll draft the console copy + screenshots. matt/priya/jack can prototype SDK API surface and infra plan. i'll loop back next week with mockups.
matt: ack, i'll start python + ts PRs for `enableRouteMeta` and add env var.
jack.platform: ack, filing infra ticket now: RD-1182 (indexing + retention).
sara: I'll add the telemetry cost calc to the toggle UX. small mock in Figma.
priya: I'll prep doc section on quota aggregation behaviors and example queries.
alyssa: perfect. small follow-up: can we also expose a per-route fallback-rate alert in console? worth a separate thread but leaving note here.
jack.platform: yes, separate alerting thread pls.
alyssa: thanks all :thumbsup:
